name: Earthmother's Pendant does not heal from periodic damage (#5130)
contract: #5130: Earthmother's Pendant (504446, aura_ascension_earthmother_pendant, AscensionPrimalistPendant.cpp) tooltip reads 'With every strike, the Earthmother’s pendant restores what was lost, healing you equal to $s1% of your damage dealt.' -- a strike is a direct hit, not a periodic bleed tick. Its spell_proc row (rev_1789936967260477700.sql) sets ProcFlags 332116, which includes PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC (0x40000), and Check() previously only tested damage->GetDamage(), so Torn to Shreds' periodic bleed (560313) also triggered the self-heal. Check() now also rejects event.GetTypeMask() & PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC. Rylak's Bite (706342) both lands a direct hit and applies the Torn to Shreds bleed in one cast: the direct hit is allowed to proc the heal (control, heal_count reaches 1), but none of the bleed's periodic ticks over its full duration may add a second heal (heal_count must stay at 1).

steps.label: Rylak's Bite: direct hit plus bleed application
control: Torn to Shreds bleed is applied
the direct hit alone is allowed to proc the pendant heal
let every periodic tick of the 12s bleed resolve
none of the periodic ticks added a second pendant heal
